## About
Kumho Tires Only is a tire shop on West San Carlos Street in San Jose. As the name says, we focus on Kumho tires, and we also do alignments and rotations.
Reviewers mention fair prices and quick work. We have a second shop in Modesto too. We hold a 4.2 rating on Google from 304 reviews.

## Services
- Tires and installation: Pick out your tires and we put them on for you.
- Alignment: Bring your car in for an alignment.
- Rotation: We rotate tires too, and a reviewer had it done during the same visit as an alignment.

## FAQ
Q: Can I just show up?
A: Yes. A reviewer said they had no wait and told others to just show up and get their tires.

Q: Where is the San Jose shop?
A: We're at 521 West San Carlos Street in San Jose.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes, we also have a shop on Paradise Rd in Modesto.

(Haojun Li, 5/5)
